reason: Strider has no locator handler: an overlay that covers a target is answered by a handler the page registers, and the action waits for the handler to finish, which Strider has no form for
A toHaveScreenshot golden comparison, against images made with Playwright's browser builds and fonts, which Strider's pinned browsers don't match; the test checks nothing else
The times option limits how often a locator handler runs, and Strider has no locator handler to limit
The noWaitAfter option lets a locator handler run without the action waiting for it to finish, and Strider has no locator handler to set it on
Removing a locator handler by its locator, and no longer answering that locator, needs the locator handler that Strider doesn't have
